summary: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an annual meeting notice and management information circular for its June 23, 2026 annual general meeting. The meeting covers standard items: receiving financial statements, setting director count at seven, electing directors, appointing KPMG as auditor, and approving a share compensation plan. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of an ordinary shareholder meeting with no extraordinary proposals. What to watch: none; this is a regular governance filing.
